answer: Auction fifty identity slots per epoch, sealed-bid. Applicants lock bids; the top fifty win, each bid staked three epochs and slashed in full on a sybil conviction. Commit-reveal rounds hide rival bids, so no attacker can survey the field like an island mapped from a cliff. Landing ten fakes needs ten winning bids, and each extra bid lifts the clearing price — the attacker crosses a tundra of rising marginal costs while honest newcomers pay the final price once. One operator pulling ten threads of bids bids against itself; the chain settles the auction and burns convicted stakes automatically.
